mapping.source: Execute unchanged pinned author definitions and per-example driver; bind imports, API clients, dataset iteration, and result storage.
mapping.transport: Reuse the existing APITarget SDK client for all target and author judge requests. Explicit model ID and single provider are required for each role; no fallback or added application retry layer.
mapping.results: Preserve original records and request traces; map author scores without adding an evaluator.
mapping.integration: Direct in-process execution; repository result dataclasses retain original records, request traces and author evaluation. No custom target, subprocess protocol or SDK-version gate.

departures.Model/provider: User-selected OpenRouter model IDs and pinned providers replace original endpoints/model IDs. Source-level author_model and judge_model labels select original code paths only; no live model equivalence is claimed.
departures.SDK: The shared OpenAI 1.109.1 client replaces the author OpenAI 1.51.2/Anthropic 0.36.0 clients. Original pins remain offline verification baselines. Tested SDK retry cases match; exhaustive SDK equivalence is not claimed.
departures.Transport: Provider routing fields are added. Claude system text becomes a system chat message and its text blocks are retained; the original 3584-token cap and response processing remain. Native Anthropic wire serialization is not preserved.
departures.Dataset/storage: Repository datasets and result logging replace original CSV loading, Excel/file output, CLI reporting and begin/end selection. No RNG seeding is added.
departures.Validation: Explicit model/provider routing validation and input-shape checks replace CLI configuration. Generic generation settings and runtime defenses are rejected.
departures.Control flow: Original builder, application retries/sleeps, stripping, optional keyword/GPT evaluation and parser are executed. CLI post-loop reporting (including original if eval bug) is outside the binding.

validation.scope: Offline source identity and author behavior comparisons with declared transport changes; no live effectiveness or paper-result claim.
validation.command: See docs/author_execution.md; run tests/test_author_execution.py, tests/test_attacks/test_flip_attack.py, tests/test_source_verification.py and the PR 01 regression suites.
validation.reference_bindings: Independent reference definitions and original loop/class from bundled official files; replace API and storage I/O only. Real SDK serializers use in-memory HTTP transports with scripted benign replies.
validation.comparisons: Prompt bytes and source request controls, omitted defaults, guidance variants, raw/stripped replies, author retries/sleeps, optional/mandatory judging, parser edge cases, error types, example order and original records. Wire expectations explicitly account for OpenRouter IDs, provider pin and Claude system-message conversion.
validation.source_result: All original references match the pinned revision in the independent official clone; runtime source bytes are unchanged after the declared attribution/header or demo extraction.
